status: DISCOVERY, historical development evidence only; nothing here is promotable
context_carried_in: the current involvement feature is an EWMA FIELD-GOAL-ATTEMPT share, deliberately not called usage rate because it excludes turnovers and free-throw trips. As a linear main effect (P2 arm G) it IMPROVED player-level deviance and made team MAE WORSE, on both tracks. ws5 exists to find out whether that is a property of THAT proxy or of the ROLE it was given.
ewma_convention: state_t = (1 - alpha) * state_(t-1) + value_t, an unnormalised exponentially weighted SUM. Identical to P1/P2. Normalisation cancels in every ratio below. State is never reset at a season boundary, matching P2.

x1_fga_share.formula: (EWMA_a=0.10[player FGA] + K/9) / (EWMA_a=0.10[team FGA] + K), K=50, strictly prior games
x1_fga_share.identical_to: turnover_p2_v1 `offensive_involvement_proxy` (arm G). Carried forward UNCHANGED so ws5 has a like-for-like incumbent proxy, not a re-tuned one.
x1_fga_share.deliberately_not_called_usage_rate: it is a field-goal-attempt share. It excludes turnovers and free-throw trips and so does not satisfy the standard usage-rate definition.

x2_pe_per36.play_ending_definition: PE = FGA + 0.44 x FTA + TOV, per prior game
x2_pe_per36.formula: 36 x (EWMA_a=0.10[player PE] + Km x r_league) / (EWMA_a=0.10[player MIN] + Km), Km=100 EWMA-weighted minutes, r_league = EWMA_a=0.10[league PE] / EWMA_a=0.10[league MIN] over strictly prior games
x2_pe_per36.why_a_rate_not_a_volume: projected offensive possessions ALREADY enter the model as the count OFFSET, so a raw EWMA volume adds no information the offset does not carry. The per-36 form asks a different question: how play-ending-dense is this player per unit of floor time.
x2_pe_per36.ft_makes_not_used: free-throw MAKES are neither required by this formula nor relied on. Only ATTEMPTS enter, through the frozen 0.44 trip weight.

x3_pe_share.formula: (EWMA_a=0.10[player PE] + K/9) / (EWMA_a=0.10[team PE] + K), K=50, strictly prior games
x3_pe_share.relation_to_x1: the same share construction as x1 with FGA replaced by PE

x4_pe_share_delta.formula: x3 computed with ALPHA_SHORT=0.35 MINUS x3 computed with ALPHA_LONG=0.10, identical shrinkage on both legs
x4_pe_share_delta.reads_as: short-term involvement rising (positive) or falling (negative) vs the long run
x4_pe_share_delta.consequence: it can be negative, so it has NO frozen positive map to a pure allocation weight. Arm P4 is declared NOT CONSTRUCTIBLE here rather than being rescued with an exponential tilt invented after the fact.

x5_involvement_rank.formula: descending rank of x3_pe_share within (game_id, team_id) over the Tier A PROJECTED candidate set, ties broken by first occurrence
x5_involvement_rank.null_when: the row is not a Tier A projected candidate for that team-game
x5_involvement_rank.allocation_map: w = exposure / rank (frozen; rank 1 is the most involved)

x6_responsibility_share.formula: x3_pe_share divided by the SUM of x3_pe_share over the Tier A projected candidates for that team-game
x6_responsibility_share.reads_as: the player's share of the club's normal play-ending responsibility AFTER teammates who are not available/projected have been removed
x6_responsibility_share.null_when: the row is not a Tier A projected candidate for that team-game

mandatory_disclosure.statement: NONE of the six proxies observes touches, passes, drives, time of possession or potential assists. No tracking data enters any of them. Every proxy is built only from box-score field-goal attempts, free-throw attempts, turnovers and minutes from STRICTLY PRIOR games, plus the already-frozen projected-exposure artifact. 'Play-ending involvement' therefore counts only possessions this player is recorded as having TERMINATED with a shot attempt, a shooting/foul trip, or a turnover. A possession the player initiated, advanced or created for a teammate is invisible to all six.
mandatory_disclosure.assists_excluded_because: assist attribution is not validated across both source eras; the P2 registration already excluded it and ws5 does not reopen it.
mandatory_disclosure.free_throw_makes: not required and not used; only FTA enters, via the frozen 0.44 weight

a_rate_predictor.design: Poisson log-link ridge, offset = log(exposure) + log(frozen Arm D rate), so beta = 0 reproduces Arm D EXACTLY. The proxy enters as a single linear main effect. lambda = 10, intercept unpenalised.

b_interaction_variable.design: features [z(x_k), z(logD), z(x_k) * z(logD)] where z() is TRAINING-FOLD standardisation and logD = log(frozen Arm D rate). The product is formed AFTER standardisation, from training-fold statistics only.
b_interaction_variable.interaction_partner_frozen_now: logD, i.e. the player's own frozen EWMA turnover history. The question the interaction asks is whether opportunity load changes HOW MUCH a player's own turnover history should be weighted. This partner is chosen HERE, before any result, and is not swapped for whichever partner turns out to work.
b_interaction_variable.nested_reference_arm: Dfree = [z(logD)] alone, so the interaction is judged against a free Arm-D coefficient rather than against Arm D itself.

c_player_allocation_weight.arms: W1..W6 (fitted, renormalised) and P1,P2,P3,P5,P6 (pure weight, unfitted)
c_player_allocation_weight.W_design: take the role-(a) fitted predictions and rescale them within (game_id, team_id) so the team total equals the Arm D team total exactly. This strips the LEVEL content and leaves only the WITHIN-TEAM allocation content. It introduces no new constant.
c_player_allocation_weight.P_design: no fit at all: pred_i = T_D(team) * w_i / sum_j w_j with w_i = exposure_i * g(x_k,i); g = identity for x1, x2, x3, x6 and g = 1/rank for x5.
c_player_allocation_weight.P4_not_constructible: x4 can be negative; declared unavailable as a pure weight, see above
c_player_allocation_weight.STRUCTURAL_CONSEQUENCE_DECLARED_IN_ADVAN: every allocation arm preserves the Arm D team total BY CONSTRUCTION, so its team-level MAE is IDENTICAL to Arm D's to floating-point. Allocation arms can therefore only ever be judged at PLAYER level. This is a property of the role, not a result, and it is written down before the run so no team-level 'tie' is later reported as evidence.

redundancy_protocol.against: the frozen P1 EWMA-shrunk turnover rate (Arm D)
measures: Pearson correlation of each proxy with D_ewma_shrunk and with log(D_ewma_shrunk)
univariate R^2 of proxy regressed on log(D)
the feature_gate `deterministic_transform_of_offset` finding, since log(D) is inside the model offset
the nested contrast R_k vs Dfree: any gain that Dfree already delivers is NOT the proxy's
redundancy_protocol.falsification_condition_from_the_ledger: all proxies are redundant with the P1 EWMA turnover rate

leakage_protocol.why_this_is_sharp_here: TURNOVERS appear inside proxies x2..x6. The regression target is also turnovers. A one-game slip in the history pass would let a proxy read its own target.
controls: a single chronological forward pass that SNAPSHOTS all EWMA state at the START of each game DATE and only consumes that date's games afterwards, so same-day games cannot see each other and no row can see itself
an INDEPENDENT recomputation probe: for a random sample of rows, rebuild the proxy from a plain `game_date < target_date` filter and assert equality to the streamed value
feature_gate.audit(target=turnovers) on every arm before any fit, saved to JSON
a shift-detector: correlation of each proxy with the CURRENT-game PE quantities is reported, and must be far below the correlation a same-game leak would produce

null_policy: PRESERVE NULLS. A proxy is NaN wherever its denominator support is genuinely zero (no prior team games) or where the row is not a Tier A projected candidate (x5, x6). Nulls are never back-filled in the artifact. Inside a fit they are mean-imputed with TRAINING-FOLD means only, via standardise-then-fillna(0), exactly as P2 did, and the null counts are reported.

tracks.intrinsic: realised offensive-possession exposure. ORACLE DIAGNOSTIC ONLY.
tracks.operational: ALL 35,629 Tier A candidate obligations with projected exposure, INCLUDING candidates who never appear. Team aggregation begins from the full pregame obligation set.

sign_convention: INCUMBENT (Arm D) absolute error MINUS CHALLENGER absolute error. POSITIVE means the challenger BEATS Arm D.

evaluation.walk_forward: expanding by SEASON; predict season Y from seasons strictly before Y
evaluation.cold_seasons: below MIN_TRAIN_ROWS the arm falls back to beta = 0, i.e. exactly Arm D
evaluation.cis: 90% cluster bootstrap, clusters = game_id, at BOTH team and player level

combined_arm_policy: an ALL-proxy arm is attempted ONLY if feature_gate.audit passes on the full six-column matrix. If the gate blocks it, the block is recorded and NO combined arm is fitted. A combined arm is never assembled from whichever proxies won.
stop_boundary: no modification of Arm D, the P1 shrinkage, the candidate universe or projected exposure
no proxy added to the bounded set of six after results are visible
preregistered_verdict_rule: the workstream SUPPORTS its hypothesis only if some proxy, in some role, delivers a positive paired mean with a 90% CI excluding zero on the OPERATIONAL track at the level that role can be judged at. Player-level deviance alone is explicitly NOT sufficient — that is precisely the trap P2 arm G fell into.
